a memorable occasion: My grandparents' fiftieth wedding anniversary was a memorable occasion, and the whole family flew home to celebrate it.
我祖父母的結婚五十週年是個難忘的場合，全家人都飛回家一起慶祝。
a memorable performance: The young pianist gave a memorable performance last night, and the audience stood up and clapped for five minutes.
那位年輕鋼琴家昨晚帶來了一場令人難忘的表演，觀眾起立鼓掌了五分鐘。
make the day memorable: We planned a surprise party with her old classmates to make the day memorable for our retiring teacher.
我們找了她的老同學辦一場驚喜派對，好讓這天對即將退休的老師來說難忘。
a memorial service: A memorial service was held at the church to remember the three firefighters who lost their lives in the fire.
教堂舉行了一場追思會，紀念在火災中喪生的三位消防員。
Memorial Day: On Memorial Day, many Americans visit cemeteries to honor the soldiers who died while serving their country.
在陣亡將士紀念日，許多美國人會到墓園向為國捐軀的軍人致敬。
a war memorial: Every year the town lays flowers at a war memorial that lists the names of local soldiers killed in battle.
每年鎮上都會在一座戰爭紀念碑前獻花，碑上刻著在戰役中陣亡的本地士兵姓名。
a memorial hall: The city built a memorial hall in honor of the famous writer, where visitors can see his letters and books.
市政府為了紀念這位知名作家蓋了一座紀念館，參觀者可以在那裡看到他的書信和著作。
mental health: Getting enough sleep and talking to friends about your worries are both important for good mental health.
睡眠充足以及和朋友聊聊你的煩惱，對良好的心理健康都很重要。
mental arithmetic: The shopkeeper added up all the prices with mental arithmetic, faster than I could do it on my phone's calculator.
店老闆用心算把所有價格加總，比我用手機計算機還快。
a mental note: I didn't have a pen, so I kept a mental note of the restaurant's name to look it up later.
我沒帶筆，所以把那家餐廳的名字留作心裡的記憶，打算之後再查。
a mental block: Whenever I see a math problem with many numbers, I get a mental block and simply cannot think clearly.
每次看到有一大堆數字的數學題，我就會出現思考障礙，完全無法清楚思考。
mental illness: Depression is a common mental illness, and people who suffer from it should be encouraged to see a doctor.
憂鬱症是一種常見的精神疾病，罹患的人應該被鼓勵去看醫生。
make a mental note: When the teacher mentioned the test date, I made a mental note to start reviewing the following weekend.
老師提到考試日期時，我暗記在心，提醒自己下個週末開始複習。
a mental picture: As she described her hometown by the sea, I formed a mental picture of white houses and blue waves.
她描述她海邊的家鄉時，我腦中浮現出白色房屋和藍色海浪的畫面。
a mere formality: Don't worry about the interview; you already have the job, so it is a mere formality.
別擔心面試；你已經拿到這份工作了，所以那只是形式而已。
the mere thought of: The mere thought of speaking in front of the whole school makes my hands shake and my heart race.
光是想到要在全校面前講話，我的手就發抖、心跳加速。
a mere child: You can't expect him to make such a big decision by himself; he is a mere child of six.
你不能期望他自己做這麼重大的決定；他只不過是個六歲的孩子。
mere words: Without real action, the mayor's promises to clean up the polluted river are nothing but mere words.
如果沒有實際行動，市長清理受汙染河川的承諾只不過是空話。
the merest hint of: At the merest hint of rain, my mother rushes outside to bring the laundry in from the balcony.
只要有一絲要下雨的跡象，我媽媽就會衝出去把陽台的衣服收進來。
make merry: On New Year's Eve, the whole village gathers in the square to eat, sing, dance, and make merry.
在除夕夜，全村的人聚集在廣場上吃東西、唱歌、跳舞，盡情歡樂。
a merry laugh: The little girl gave a merry laugh as her father pushed her higher and higher on the swing.
爸爸把小女孩的鞦韆推得越來越高時，她發出了一陣歡快的笑聲。
the more the merrier: You can bring your cousins to the barbecue too—the more the merrier, and we have plenty of food.
你也可以帶你的表兄弟姊妹來烤肉——人越多越熱鬧，而且我們食物很多。
Merry Christmas: Before leaving for the holidays, the students wished their teacher a Merry Christmas and gave her a handmade card.
放假離開前，學生們祝老師聖誕快樂，並送她一張手作卡片。
a messy divorce: After a messy divorce that involved lawyers and a long fight over the house, the couple stopped speaking to each other.
經歷一場鬧得很難看、還請了律師並為房子爭執許久的離婚後，這對夫妻不再跟彼此說話。
a messy situation: When two classmates both claimed the same award, the teacher had to deal with a messy situation.
當兩位同學都聲稱同一個獎是自己的時，老師不得不處理一個混亂棘手的局面。
get messy: Painting with young children can get messy, so cover the table with old newspapers before you begin.
和幼兒一起畫畫可能會變得一團糟，所以開始前先在桌上鋪舊報紙。
a messy business: Cleaning out a fish tank is a messy business, so wear old clothes and put a towel on the floor.
清理魚缸是件棘手麻煩的事，所以要穿舊衣服，並在地上鋪條毛巾。
a metropolitan area: More than seven million people live in the Taipei metropolitan area, which includes both Taipei and New Taipei City.
超過七百萬人住在台北大都會區，範圍涵蓋台北市和新北市。
the metropolitan police: In London, the metropolitan police are responsible for keeping order in the city's crowded streets and stations.
在倫敦，都會警察負責維持城市擁擠街道和車站的秩序。
metropolitan life: After years of busy metropolitan life with its traffic and tall buildings, my uncle moved to a quiet village.
在經歷多年充滿車潮和高樓的忙碌大都會生活後，我叔叔搬到了一個安靜的村莊。
